a: Record Every act on every layer, by a person or an agent, in one trail.

p: Send a request to api.hanzo.ai and name a model. The same request reaches Enso, Zen or a model another lab serves, in the wire format your client already speaks — OpenAI chat completions and responses, or Anthropic messages.
Operations on api.hanzo.ai. One key reaches every layer.

table: Returns the models the routing table serves.

code: curl https://api.hanzo.ai/v1/chat/completions \ -H " Authorization: Bearer $ HANZO_API_KEY " \ -H " Content-Type: application/json " \ -d ' {"model": "zen5", "messages": [{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}]} '
